import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# --- Data (ρ=0.4, seed42) ---
tau = [0.50, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90, 0.95]
ppl = [17.688, 17.6805, 17.6793, 17.6527, 17.712, 17.723]
uniform_ppl = 17.6939
ess_only_ppl = 17.73

# --- Style: Nature/ICML ---
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Times New Roman'],
    'mathtext.fontset': 'stix',
    'font.size': 12,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.8,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.8,
    'xtick.direction': 'in',
    'ytick.direction': 'in',
    'xtick.top': True,
    'ytick.right': True,
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

# Adaptive PPL curve
ax.plot(tau, ppl, 'o-', color='#1f77b4', linewidth=1.8, markersize=7,
        markerfacecolor='#1f77b4', markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.2,
        label='Adaptive weighting', zorder=3)

# Uniform baseline
ax.axhline(y=uniform_ppl, color='#7f7f7f', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2,
           label=f'Uniform baseline ({uniform_ppl:.4f})', zorder=2)

# ESS-only baseline
ax.axhline(y=ess_only_ppl, color='#d62728', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.2,
           label=f'ESS-only ({ess_only_ppl:.2f})', zorder=2)

# Annotate optimal τ=0.8
opt_idx = tau.index(0.80)
ax.annotate(r'$\tau^*\!=\!0.8$',
            xy=(0.80, ppl[opt_idx]),
            xytext=(0.65, 17.638),
            fontsize=11,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#333333', lw=1.0,
                            connectionstyle='arc3,rad=-0.15'),
            color='#333333', ha='center', va='top', zorder=4)

# Axes
ax.set_xlabel(r'Temperature $\tau$')
ax.set_ylabel('Holdout Perplexity')
ax.set_xticks(tau)
ax.set_xticklabels([f'{t:.2f}' for t in tau])
ax.set_xlim(0.45, 1.00)
ax.set_ylim(17.63, 17.75)

# Legend
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=True, framealpha=0.95, edgecolor='#cccccc',
          fontsize=10, handlelength=2.0)

fig.tight_layout(pad=0.5)

# Save
out = '/root/provenance_weight_training/output/figures/tau_sweep'
fig.savefig(out + '.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
fig.savefig(out + '.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {out}.pdf')
print(f'Saved: {out}.png')
